what_it_is: Crotch is a men's underwear and swimwear magazine built from photographic editorials of male models in briefs, jocks and swim shorts, shot by a rotating cast of photographers, with brand collaborations and short features on sexuality and body image. Issues appear about twice a year with many alternative covers (Issue 15 has eight) plus occasional city specials such as New York and California. It is for an adult, largely gay male readership and collectors of body-focused fashion print.
